**The build passes now.** Your hunch was right. Two real bugs, both from the bump.

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`. The new name is `retryCount`. It now accepts either.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on an unset flag. Unset now means off, as before.

The 8 remaining warnings are just noise from the fake bundler's own log.
